title: Dell OpenManage Enterprise, versions prior to 4.8.0, contains an Improper Neutralization of Special Elements used in…
description: Dell OpenManage Enterprise versions prior to 4.8.0 contain an OS command injection vulnerability due to improper neutralization of special elements. This flaw allows a low-privileged remote attacker to execute arbitrary commands on the affected system without user interaction. The vulnerability has a high severity rating with a CVSS score of 8.8.
